set.description: Run a non-interactive command on the workstation inside a selected project root of the target workspace (explicit project_root, or the workspace's single current project root) and return its bounded result synchronously: start a durable native exec session, wait up to timeout_ms, then return exit_code + effective_cwd/project_root + output. Ordinary roots do not open a pane and never depend on a pane's foreground cwd. When the workspace has MULTIPLE project roots and project_root is omitted, the call is REFUSED and returns candidates (one of them is the exact value to pass next). Gated by HERDR_MCP_READONLY / HERDR_MCP_WRITE_ROOTS. If any agent in that project is working, refused unless confirm_busy:true (returns warnings.working). Freeform shell is NOT secret-path gated (unlike herdr_fs_* — a command can still read .env); prefer fs tools for file IO. On timeout the command keeps running as the returned session_id; partial output is returned with ok:false code:exec_timeout and must be resumed with herdr_exec_read, never re-sent. macOS user-protected roots (Documents/Desktop/Downloads) use the persistent VISIBLE utility pane (label 'herdr-mcp:utility') so execution stays under the TCC-authorized Herdr terminal host.
